-- Update March 29 giving to the correct PCO figures
-- Total: $172,713.49, 408 donors (donationCount), 4 new donors, 241 recurring
-- The table only has donationCount, total, general, designated — no separate new/recurring donor fields
UPDATE giving_weekly
SET total = 172713.49,
    general = 172713.49,
    designated = 0.00,
    donationCount = 408
WHERE weekStartDate = '2026-03-29'
  AND campus = 'All Campuses';

-- Verify
SELECT weekStartDate, campus, total, donationCount
FROM giving_weekly
WHERE weekStartDate = '2026-03-29'
